title: DB-2.7 Qualify the local-first desktop workbench end to end

authority.architecture: Linear P-RES-35 — DynamisBench (Architecture, ADR register, locked stack)
authority.scientific_boundary: M1 preserved; no simulator, numerical claim, visualization or packaging work added

gates.name: Real sidecar process and security boundary
gates.claim: The actual development launch spec starts one secured API on 127.0.0.1 with an operating-system-assigned port; readiness, authentication refusal, exact-origin CORS, bounded real-process failures, one-session ownership and clean shutdown are proved without a fake supervisor.
evidence: python/tests/api/test_sidecar_process.py (34 real-process Python cases, including the stdin shutdown record and malformed-control refusal)
limitations: The credential is generated per session and never appears in stdout, stderr, the readiness record, the event payload, a URL or a report.
The force-termination path is covered by the Rust fake-child supervision gates and the Python terminate gate; the real-process shutdown exercised here is the supervisor's graceful path.

gates.name: Real temporary workspace authority workflow
gates.claim: A live secured API opens real temporary roots, mints an opaque identifier, discovers and selects artifacts, re-reads and revalidates valid and invalid JSON, publishes semantic digests that an independent computation reproduces, refuses cross-workspace/stale/traversal/linked requests without disclosure, and preserves the source and evidence trees byte for byte.
evidence: python/tests/api/live_sidecar.py (real secured process and snapshot helper)
evidence/m2/native-observation.json (the same authority read from the native desktop shell)
limitations: The workspace roots are test-owned temporary roots, never a research root.
An external edit is the only thing that changes the next inspection; the API creates no cache, index or side file.

gates.name: Pinned Playwright/Chromium browser qualification
gates.claim: Chromium drives the production route tree, session provider, typed client, Explorer, inspector, re-read control, Activity feed and keyboard semantics against a real secured Python sidecar. A normal browser without the test bridge still reports the production unavailable state.
evidence: apps/workbench/playwright.config.ts (pinned Chromium, one worker, no traces/screenshots/videos/HAR)
apps/workbench/vite.e2e.config.ts (test-only application root; not used by pnpm build)
gates.simulated_component: The desktop shell's two session IPC facts are supplied by an explicitly named browser-test transport in e2e/app/bridge.ts. It is absent from the production build, and no production session fallback was added.
limitations: This is browser-grade evidence, not native WebView2 evidence.
The test-only bridge is a simulated Tauri session transport; it is not a production path.

gates.name: Failure, replacement, reconnection and Arrow transport
gates.claim: A real sidecar loss is visibly classified and leaves no credential or read model; a replacement session invalidates old workspace IDs and old bearer proof while reopening the same roots yields the same digest under a fresh identifier; SSE refuses, fails, reconnects with its bounded policy and never replays; a delayed previous selection cannot republish authority; the 832-byte Arrow IPC fixture is identical in Python and JavaScript.
limitations: The reconnect assertion uses a controlled network reset on the first connection of a new session; the retry is then served by the real sidecar.
Restart is simulated by terminating and relaunching the application/sidecar session; no restart command was exposed.

gates.name: Native Windows Tauri development desktop
gates.claim: The real Tauri development shell ran with WebView2 and the locked Python sidecar. Readiness, workspace opening, discovery, valid/invalid inspection, Activity events, clean shutdown and a clean relaunch were observed directly.
limitations: Manual UI Automation and reviewed window-content screenshots, not automated visual regression.
Not scientific validation; no simulator was executed.
The observation is Windows-native only and is not cross-platform desktop evidence.

On this host the locked environment's python.exe ran the server in a child interpreter; graceful shutdown contained the whole API process tree and socket, but the gate does not claim a single OS process.

skips: Windows file symbolic link unavailable without Developer Mode/elevation (junction case proves the shared rejection)
Linux port-reservation socket option absent (loopback/ephemeral/bind-once gates prove the rest)
Linux filesystem accepts the reference length (the reference bound is proved by the naming gates)

preserved_contracts: Tauri single command `get_api_session` and single event `dynamisbench-api-status`
Tauri ACL grants only core:event:allow-listen and core:event:allow-unlisten
Read-only authority inspection; no write route or client-side authority cache
M1 domain, identity, workspace, evidence, planning and import boundaries
Query owns server state; Zustand owns UI-local state
Closed SSE payloads and bounded retention; no persistence or replay
No simulator execution, scientific visualization or M8 packaging work
claim_ceiling: M2 proves local application/product plumbing and read-only authority inspection.
It does not prove simulator execution, numerical validity, scientific visualization, remote deployment or packaging/release readiness.
A green CI matrix proves portable software behaviour and browser-grade UI behaviour; it does not prove native interaction on a human's machine or scientific validity.
The native Gate 5 observation is Windows-specific and manual; it is not reproduced by Linux CI.
Independent acceptance is required before RES-380 can move to Done.

unmodified_scientific_authority.note: The committed gate fixtures are test authority, not user research roots; every live run used temporary roots and left them byte-identical apart from the one controlled external edit the re-read case performs.

working_tree: clean at the tested implementation commit; this record is an evidence-only addition on top of the merged implementation
